title: Body Parts Fun
yt_description:
Learn the basic body parts with Pip, Lulu, and Bo. This song teaches young children to identify and name their head, shoulders, hands, and feet. Encourages physical awareness and vocabulary building.

🎵 Body Parts Fun

Hello friends
Let's play
Today we learn

Head on top
Shoulders strong
Hands to play

Body parts
We can see
Me and you

Hands to clap
Feet to move
Let's groove

Body parts
We can see
Me and you
Bye for now

Bouncy Meadow — Kids Songs with Pip, Lulu & Bo
Animation and music created with AI tools, written and reviewed by a human.
